title: They work and they are so simple to use
text: They work and they are so simple to use. I could never truss my chickens until now! These are so easy to use and for me, they’re great being I have arthritis in my hands really bad! These are amazing!

product_metadata.title: Clucker-Truss Gourmet Elastic Trussing Strings; 6 Inch White Heavy Duty (80 pack, White)
features: CLUCKER-TRUSS: Replaces traditional cooking string, butcher twine, or ties received with purchase of rotisserie ovens; No tying necessary
ELASTIC: Provides stretch and ease of application; adjusts to maintain tight truss during cooking process

USE: Hold legs and wings of poultry in place during rotisserie or conventional roasting or frying; Tie roasts and chops; Hold together pre-sliced ham and rib racks; Bundle vegetables for steaming; Secure pinwheels or other specialty products

VERSATILE: Can be used in conventional, rotisserie, microwave, or convection ovens; Also on stove top, grill; in fryers and multi-cookers such as the Instant Pot; Heat safe to 500 degrees Fahrenheit; Can be used for freezer storage.
SAFE: Approved for use in Food; BPA free; Made of food-grade material
description: The Clucker-Truss elastic trussing band is designed to secure the legs and wings of poultry firmly to the body, facilitating the rotisserie process. The increased elasticity of the Clucker-Truss makes it easy to apply and offers extraordinary holding power that keeps the wings and legs of the birds intact throughout the cooking process. Its many valuable features will benefit processors, retailers and consumers alike. The Clucker-Truss can also be used to hold together roasts, rib racks, pre-sliced ham, pinwheels, bacon wrapped filets, vegetable bundles, and other specialty products. The 5" bands can stretch to fit up to a 4.5-pound roasting chicken. Use multiple strings to secure your roast before searing and roasting or cooking in your multi-cooker. Our elastic bands are heat resistant up to 500 degrees Fahrenheit and can be used in conventional, rotisserie, microwave, or convection ovens; as well as on the stove top, grill, or in any multi-cooker such as the Instant Pot. Do not expose to direct flame. Approved for use in Food.
